strengths.I002-v2: A genuinely new mechanism: a sign-preserving one-factor stress covariance blended by the absorption ratio, so ERC moves toward whichever hedge currently works (Treasuries in flight-to-quality, gold and commodities in 2022), plus an all-time-peak CPPI taper with an explicit worst-case path (about 17.8%) and a fully specified M/W/F 6%-per-session scheduler.
strengths.I003-v2: Very simple and transparent: three-cluster inverse-vol parity with equal standalone cluster risk by rule, a cushion-droop exposure that reaches zero at 16% DD leaving a 4% slippage reserve, and a daily ramp cap that puts turnover and trade-frequency inside the control law, with few parameters.

verdicts.reason: I002 adds a new regime-aware covariance mechanism that addresses correlated stock-bond stress directly and carries a worst-case drawdown estimate, whereas I003 is a competent but fairly textbook cluster parity plus CPPI whose decaying peak can also let true all-time drawdown creep past the bound.

strengths.I002-v2: Stress-mixture ERC whose crisis covariance follows the sample's own loading signs, with an all-time-peak taper, an explicit worst-case scenario (calm book loses 9.4% then four 5% weeks, max DD about 17.8%), and a fully specified scheduler.
strengths.I004-v2: A clear contingency-reserve idea: size the book so a stress-tail 20-day loss of all clusters together still leaves DD under 16%, with a derived 0.20 floor, asymmetric shed/restore ramps and trend-to-cash.

verdicts.reason: I002 measures drawdown from the all-time peak and adapts its correlation structure to the current crisis, while I004 relies on hand-set loss priors, a 756-day peak that lets chained episodes exceed the bound, and an unresolved major critique.

strengths.I002-v2: A taper that de-risks in proportion to drawdown with a reasoned worst-case estimate and a sign-aware stress prior that adapts to whichever hedges work in the current crisis, and per-session turnover caps that satisfy both constraints by construction.
strengths.I008-v2: Combines several sensible defences (stress-day covariance, class budgets shifting from rates to real assets when stock-bond correlation is positive, trend gates, staggered one-fifth-gap daily trading) and the daily ramp fits the constraints naturally.

verdicts.reason: I008's CPPI floor only reaches zero exposure at 20% drawdown, so it has no slippage reserve, and its one-fifth-per-day gap trading is slow in a fast crash, while I002's taper is calibrated to 18% with a worked worst case; I008 also stacks more tuned components.
